content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Before the correction, we had a tentative human attribution of HarborMesh checklist comment c1200, signed River, to Mara.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The human reporter explicitly said they were unsure; this was not an established identity.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"Our code body received that human report on 2026-07-01.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The checklist proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reported that we wanted to try it at the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"On 2026-07-04, our code body received tool information conveying the author's correction.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The author said they were not Mara Ibarra and asked us to credit their River account.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"River's login is river-tools, account ID 2901; Mara's known Forge login remains mara-river, account ID 1847.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"River had not supplied a real name, and the supplied memories do not record whether we tried the checklist.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
